title: Game-Theoretic Foundations for Undiscounted Bisimulation Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2610.38313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bisimulation metrics offer a principled notion of task-relevant state similarity in reinforcement learning, but existing constructions and methods are largely confined to discounted MDPs, where contraction arguments ensure well-defined fixed points and downstream guarantees. We develop a unified foundation for bisimulation metrics in undiscounted settings, that is total- and average-reward problems, by replacing the standard operator-centric view with a game-centric one: we interpret prior metric operators as Bellman-Shapley operators of zero-sum turn-based games and define metrics as the corresponding game value functions, yielding unique definitions even when $\gamma=1$. This game-theoretic foundation facilitates transfer of dynamic-programming theory and algorithms. We also use this game-centric perspective to characterize how metric finiteness depends on structural properties of the underlying MDP and motivate certain directed metric

translated_title: 无折扣双模拟度量的博弈论基础
translated_abstract: 双模拟度量为强化学习中的任务相关状态相似性提供了一个原则性的概念，但现有的构造和方法大多局限于折扣马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中压缩（收缩）论证能够确保明确定义的不动点以及下游任务的理论保证。我们为无折扣设定（即总奖励和平均奖励问题）下的双模拟度量建立了一个统一的基础，方法是将标准的算子中心视角替换为博弈中心视角：我们将先前的度量算子解释为零和轮次博弈的Bellman-Shapley算子，并将度量定义为相应的博弈值函数，从而即使在γ=1时也能获得唯一的定义。这一博弈论基础便于动态规划理论与算法向该设定的迁移。我们还利用这一博弈中心视角刻画了度量的有限性如何依赖于底层MDP的结构性质，并由此启发了某些有向度量
tldr: 本文提出以博弈论为中心的新视角，将双模拟度量算子解释为零和轮次博弈的Bellman-Shapley算子，从而为无折扣（总奖励与平均奖励）强化学习中的双模拟度量建立了统一的理论基础，即使在γ=1时也能保证度量的唯一定义。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified game-theoretic foundation for bisimulation metrics in undiscounted (total- and average-reward) reinforcement learning by interpreting prior metric operators as Bellman-Shapley operators of zero-sum turn-based games, yielding unique metric definitions even when γ=1.
